items.title: Q&A: How 3PLs are navigating the latest pharma trends
items.summary: As regulatory expectations rise and advanced therapies push cold-chain complexity, 3PLs are investing in validated infrastructure, network-wide quality systems, and data-driven visibility.

items.title: CVC consortium tables $12.4bn bid to delist Italian drugmaker Recordati
items.summary: The tender offer is for €51.29 per share, representing a 13% premium on Recordati’s share price before the takeover was first disclosed.

items.title: Accelerate post-approval research by streamlining the entire study lifecycle
items.summary: Paradigm Health’s SPIRE platform streamlines post-approval oncology research with pragmatic, prospective studies embedded in routine care

items.title: European STI cases reach record high amid testing and prevention gaps
items.summary: Cases of syphilis and gonorrhoea have tripled and quadrupled, respectively, since 2015, highlighting the need for effective treatments.

items.title: Gilead Sciences completes Tubulis acquisition for $5bn
items.summary: Gilead Sciences has concluded its acquisition of Germany-based biotechnology company Tubulis in a transaction valued at up to $5bn.
